caption:
Friday's Sky is Yang Wood, The Great Tree 🌳 Find your element below.

Your element is the element of the day you were born. Today's tall tree meets it and creates one of 10 forces: Yang Wood gets a friend day, Yang Water gets a joy day, Yang Earth feels the pressure.

Don't know yours? Find it free at the link in bio.

Tag someone whose line is spot on.

#skyandseason #innerconstellation #astrology #selfdiscovery #personalgrowth #metaphysics #bazi #chinesemetaphysics #fiveelements #fridayfeeling
day_line: A great tree on a Monkey day. Tall and quick-witted: good for starting things and solving puzzles, easy to take on too much.

lines.Yang Wood: Your allies show up today. Ask for backup; you don't have to carry it alone.
lines.Yin Wood: A friendly contest today. Let them win the small one; you'll take the next.
lines.Yang Fire: You read the room fast today. Trust it, but check the facts before you act.
lines.Yin Fire: Help arrives quietly today. Accept the lift home and say thanks properly.
lines.Yang Earth: The to-do list grows legs today. Pick three; the rest can wait.
lines.Yin Earth: Your effort gets seen today. Show the work; let others do the praising.
lines.Yang Metal: A good deal crosses your path today. If it's a big one, sleep on it.
lines.Yin Metal: Friday treat time. Set the budget first, then enjoy every bite.
lines.Yang Water: Weekend mood starts early today. Plan something fun that fits the budget.
lines.Yin Water: You'll say what everyone is thinking today. Pick kind words; the timing's good.
